notes.text: The body gives only אמר רב (Rav said) and ערכין ה: (Arakhin 5b by the colon convention). The bracketed He reported supplies the entry-subject reading contextually; the saying itself is not supplied. The original note's uncertainty about the connection is preserved, without treating the brevity as proven textual loss.
